headline: Barracuda ties its cloud breach to ARTEX; Uber breach exposed ~150,000 driver's licenses; PHP2Shell chained attacks on Check Point gateways

bullets.text: New: Dark Reading reports ransomware attacks are increasing with AI help while ransom payments decline. n0n (80), INC Ransom (51) and The Gentlemen (40) led leak-site claims this week. SITCON 3 (ELEVATED), unchanged; the last 7 days score 1.05x the 90-day average.

Still active: Barracuda links its cloud breach to the ARTEX AI-powered attack tool, per BleepingComputer; ARTEX is the only 3-outlet story. Barracuda CVE-2026-111560 and ESG CVE-2026-116606 went on KEV 11-10 and are past their 11-13 deadline.

Still active, critical: a PHP2Shell flaw is exploited in chained attacks on unpatched Check Point gateways (no CVE given). Check Point CVE-2026-123039 and UnrealIRCd CVE-2026-114713 hit their KEV deadline today (11-16).

Breaches: Uber says hackers stole information on close to 150,000 driver's licenses, per TechCrunch. Also on the board: Douglas County, Nevada SSN leak, Fandango checkout card theft, Coles, and Lithuania's customs agency.

Still active: China-nexus actors breached 10 organizations in AI-driven attacks (Dark Reading). Amazon found an AI agent campaign hunting LiteLLM and Dify for API keys, and SANS sees scans for CVE-2026-42271 and CVE-2026-48710.
Still active: the Cursor supply chain attack started at Fireworks AI, per SecurityWeek; no affected versions given. 300 malicious npm and PyPI packages were listed in the last 7 days.

actions: Barracuda customers: patch CVE-2026-111560 and ESG CVE-2026-116606 now, review cloud account access and follow Barracuda's breach advisory.
Check Point gateways: apply all current fixes including CVE-2026-123039, restrict management access and hunt for PHP2Shell chained compromise.
AI gateways (LiteLLM, Dify): patch CVE-2026-42271 and CVE-2026-48710, keep admin endpoints private and rotate stored API keys.
Cursor and Fireworks AI users: follow vendor advisories, review installed extensions and rotate tokens or keys those tools can reach.
Ransomware readiness: confirm offline backups and restore tests, and watch for phishing that reuses leaked Uber driver's license details.
Queue KEV fixes: Apple CVE-2024-27834 due 11-18, SonicWall SSLVPN 11-20, Outlook, Cisco BroadWorks, Openwave and Chromium 11-24.
